scope: Source integrity, exact joins, unchanged parent measurements, explicit Earth screening. Not independent analog suitability validation.

environment_flag_definitions.1: Land-cover evidence missing, invalid, or below 95% strict area coverage
environment_flag_definitions.2: Aridity evidence missing, invalid, or below 95% area coverage
environment_flag_definitions.4: Less than 80% of cell area is strictly classified as barren
environment_flag_definitions.8: More than 5% of cell area is classified as water
environment_flag_definitions.16: More than 1% of cell area is classified as built-up
environment_flag_definitions.32: More than 5% of cell area is classified as cropland or crop mosaic
